description.value: Caffè Mira is a Vancouver neighbourhood coffee shop that opened its first location in 2017 and has since grown to three locations across the city and New Westminster. The Main Street location sits on one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors and offers dine-in or takeout with a menu of beverages, sandwiches, and pastries. Catering and third-party delivery (DoorDash, Uber Eats, SkipTheDishes) are also available.
